scripts.build: npm run build:builder && npm run build:types && npm run build:mjs && npm run build:mjs-bundle && npm run build:mjs-bundle-minify && npm run build:mjs-bundle-no-external
scripts.build:builder: esbuild src/builder.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:typescript --external:esbuild --outfile=build-builder/builder.mjs && mkdir -p bin && { echo '#!/usr/bin/env node'; cat build-builder/builder.mjs; } > bin/builder.mjs && chmod +x bin/builder.mjs
scripts.build:dist-mjs: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-mjs', { recursive: true, force: true })" && npx builder --type=module --sourceMap --outDir=dist-mjs && node dist-mjs/index.mjs
scripts.build:dist-types: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-types', { recursive: true, force: true })" && npx builder --type=types --outDir=dist-types
scripts.build:mjs: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('build-mjs', { recursive: true, force: true })" && bin/builder.mjs --type=module --outDir=build-mjs
scripts.build:mjs-bundle: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('build-mjs-bundle', { recursive: true, force: true })" && bin/builder.mjs --type=module --outDir=build-mjs-bundle --entryPoint=index.test.ts --outFile=index.test.mjs
scripts.build:mjs-bundle-minify: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('build-mjs-bundle-minify', { recursive: true, force: true })" && bin/builder.mjs --type=module --minify --outDir=build-mjs-bundle-minify --entryPoint=index.test.ts --outFile=index.test.mjs
scripts.build:mjs-bundle-no-external: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('build-mjs-bundle-no-external', { recursive: true, force: true })" && bin/builder.mjs --type=module --external=./node_modules/* --outDir=build-mjs-bundle-no-external --entryPoint=index.test.ts --outFile=index.test.mjs --minify
scripts.build:types: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('build-types', { recursive: true, force: true })" && bin/builder.mjs --type=types --outDir=build-types
scripts.ci:test: npm run build && npm run test:node && npm run test:mjs && npm run test:mjs-bundle && npm run test:mjs-bundle-no-external
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build:builder && npm run build:dist-types && npm run build:dist-mjs
scripts.test: npm run ci:compile && npm run ci:test && npm run ci:lint && npm run ci:style
